description: Save some breath for the answer

participation.context: Heard the wrong breath and moved two stops.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Made Nick walk it and named the pint.
participation.name: Augustine Phillips

participation.context: Walked the speech and kept breath for the answer.
participation.name: Nick Sorrell

participation.context: Reached the door too soon, and was told to sit and copy.
participation.name: Sam Latchet

story.body: You changed your pointing, not Nick's labour. Sam was set to copy the new stops sitting down. No word of the speech was changed, and the speech itself is not set down.

title: Moved two stops in Nick's speech

description: A cue roll in a boy's hands

participation.context: Looked, and did not add a word.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Held the roll. His face was not in it.
participation.name: Nick Sorrell

story.body: You let the two new marks stand in Nick's hands, and you did not copy the speech out.

title: Looked at the cue roll in Nick's hands
